title: How to Round Prices Fast While Shopping
description: A number-line trick for quickly estimating totals at checkout by rounding to the nearest dollar.
narration_lines: Rounding helps you estimate totals while shopping.
Here's a number line from 0 to 10 dollars.
8 dollars 70 sits between 8 and 9, much closer to 9.
It rounds up to 9 dollars. Handy for a quick checkout estimate.
